description: Pins are tracked, not floated (audit T9): every image is tag+digest, every action a SHA, both lockfiles refreshed. One grouped PR a week per area; security updates any time.

customManagers.description: Images pulled by the dagger module (.dagger/main.go const block): <repo>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>
Images referenced by digest in workflow run: steps (Trivy for the SBOM)
dagger engine version: dagger.json engineVersion and the dagger-for-github `version:` input must stay equal

Riksarkivet/universalviewer4 commit the web image builds UV from (.docker/htrflow-web.dockerfile). The bun and node stages of that file are covered by the dockerfile manager; this ARG is not. Bumping it may need .docker/uv4-uv-html.patch re-derived, so it gets its own PR.

AI-Riksarkivet/htrflow commit the arm64 wrapper base is built from (.github/workflows/{ci,publish}.yml build it natively on an arm64 runner). Bumping it rebuilds that base, so it gets its own PR; keep the two workflows on the same commit.
Trivy image used by make scan-web

packageRules.description: Container images anywhere (dockerfiles, chart values, dagger module, workflows): one weekly PR
The htrflow base is a deliberate, tested pin: tag bumps by hand, digest refreshes only
The arm64 wrapper base is a local tag built in the same job from source, not a registry image — there is nothing to look up
The htrflow commit the arm64 base is built from: its own PR, the base and the wrapper on top of it must be re-verified
torch/torchvision follow the cu128 index by hand (dockerfile comment); uv itself is a pin
The Universal Viewer fork commit: its own PR — the uv4-uv-html.patch may need re-deriving against it
GitHub Actions: SHA pins with the version comment kept; one weekly PR
dagger engine (dagger.json + workflow version input): its own PR, the module must be re-verified
Python dev tools (ruff, ty, pytest, moto) from the workspace lock
Python runtime deps of both members: grouped, patch+minor only; majors get their own PR
Campaign browser (bun.lock): one weekly PR, majors separate
